title: Synthetic customer-support guideline drift benchmark
description: Ten synthetic policy revisions with explicit stale-label ground truth.

cases.title: Unauthorized purchase exception overrides refund routing

oldGuideline.text: Route requests to return money for completed purchases to Billing Refunds. Route card-security questions that do not request a transaction refund to Fraud Review. Billing Refunds takes precedence whenever a refund is requested.

newGuideline.text: Route requests to return money for completed purchases to Billing Refunds. Route unauthorized, stolen-card, or card-compromise purchases to Fraud Review even when the customer requests a refund. This fraud exception takes precedence over Billing Refunds.

cases.changeSummary: Fraud Review now overrides Billing Refunds for unauthorized or stolen-card purchases.

records.text: Please refund the headphones I returned yesterday.
How can I freeze my card before anything is purchased?
My card was stolen and the thief bought a camera. Refund that purchase.
I changed my mind about the annual plan and want my money back.
The replacement card for my stolen card has not arrived.
Someone tried to log in, but there are no unknown charges.
Refund the damaged suitcase from order 731.
I never authorized this game purchase. Reverse it and secure my card.
Why was the refund for my legitimate purchase declined?
I recognize the purchase now; please close the fraud inquiry.

rationales.fraud-03: The purchase followed a stolen card and the new exception overrides the requested refund.
rationales.fraud-08: The customer explicitly says the purchase was unauthorized, so Fraud Review now takes precedence.

cases.title: Identity-verification login blocks move to account security

oldGuideline.text: Route all sign-in failures, password errors, and login loops to Technical Access. Route reports of account takeover to Account Security.

newGuideline.text: Route ordinary sign-in failures, password errors, and login loops to Technical Access. Route login blocks caused by identity verification, selfie checks, or document checks to Account Security, along with account takeover reports.

cases.changeSummary: Identity-verification login blocks are now Account Security rather than Technical Access.

records.text: The login page spins forever after I enter my password.
The selfie identity check keeps rejecting me, so I cannot sign in.
I forgot my password and the reset email is late.
A stranger changed the email on my account.
The mobile app closes immediately after launch.
My passport document check failed and now login is blocked.
Can I update my profile photo?
Two-factor authentication worked, but the dashboard is blank.
I received a sign-in alert that was mine.
The password field does not accept pasted text.

rationales.access-02: The failed selfie check is an identity-verification login block.
rationales.access-06: The failed passport check is a document-verification login block.

cases.title: Deceased-owner requests receive a dedicated route

oldGuideline.text: Route every subscription cancellation and account closure request to Retention. Route inheritance questions without an account action to General Legal.

newGuideline.text: Route ordinary subscription cancellation and account closure requests to Retention. Route requests involving a deceased account owner, executor, death certificate, or estate to Estate Support.

cases.changeSummary: Closures involving a deceased owner or estate now go to Estate Support.

records.text: Cancel my monthly membership before it renews.
I am executor for my late father's estate and need his account closed.
Pause my subscription for two months.
Where can I download last year's invoices?
I have a general question about beneficiary law.
Close the duplicate account I created this morning.
My mother died; where do I send her death certificate to cancel service?
Please transfer my account to a different email.
The owner is travelling and asked me to cancel for them.
Reactivate the account I closed last week.

rationales.estate-02: The executor is closing an account belonging to a deceased owner.
rationales.estate-07: The death certificate and deceased-owner cancellation require Estate Support.

cases.title: Spoiled perishables split from ordinary damaged returns

oldGuideline.text: Route every item reported damaged, broken, leaking, or spoiled on arrival to Damaged Returns. Route late but usable deliveries to Delivery Delay.

newGuideline.text: Route broken or damaged durable goods to Damaged Returns. Route food, medicine, flowers, and other perishable goods that arrive spoiled, warm, wilted, or unsafe to Perishable Quality.

cases.changeSummary: Spoiled or unsafe perishable deliveries now go to Perishable Quality.

records.text: The ceramic mug arrived with its handle broken.
The frozen meal arrived warm and smells spoiled.
My laptop box was dented but the laptop works.
The flowers arrived wilted and brown.
The courier arrived a day late, but everything is usable.
The glass bottle cracked during shipping.
I received the wrong color shirt.
The sealed cereal box is slightly crushed.
The tracking page has not updated.
A screw is missing from the chair kit.

rationales.quality-02: A warm, spoiled frozen meal is a perishable-quality issue.
rationales.quality-04: Wilted flowers are explicitly covered by the new perishable category.

cases.title: Statutory deletion requests split from normal account closure

oldGuideline.text: Route requests to delete a profile or account to Account Settings. Route questions about stored personal data to Privacy Questions.

newGuideline.text: Route ordinary profile or account deletion to Account Settings. Route requests invoking GDPR, CCPA, right to erasure, statutory deletion, or deletion of all retained personal data to Privacy Rights.

cases.changeSummary: Deletion requests invoking a legal privacy right now go to Privacy Rights.

records.text: Delete the empty profile I made by mistake.
I invoke my GDPR right to erasure; delete all personal data you retain.
How do I change the name shown on my profile?
What personal information do you store about me?
Close my account because I no longer use it.
Under CCPA, remove every copy of my personal information.
Remove one old shipping address from my profile.
Do you sell anonymized statistics?
I cannot find the delete-account button.
Unsubscribe me from promotional email.

rationales.privacy-02: The request explicitly invokes GDPR and deletion of retained personal data.
rationales.privacy-06: The request explicitly invokes CCPA and comprehensive personal-data removal.

cases.title: Security vulnerabilities override ordinary bug routing

oldGuideline.text: Route crashes, incorrect behavior, exposed error messages, and API defects to Technical Bugs. Route confirmed account theft to Account Security.

newGuideline.text: Route ordinary crashes and functional defects to Technical Bugs. Route suspected vulnerabilities, exposed credentials, authorization bypasses, or access to another customer's data to Security Incident, even if described as a bug.

cases.changeSummary: Suspected vulnerabilities and cross-customer data exposure now require Security Incident routing.

records.text: The app crashes when I open notification settings.
Changing the invoice ID in the URL lets me see another customer's invoice.
The API returns a 500 error for an empty name.
A debug page displays a live production API secret.
The export button creates an empty file.
My own session expired too quickly.
Someone took over my account yesterday.
The help page contains a broken link.
The page shows my own email twice.
I cannot upload a profile image larger than 2 MB.

rationales.security-02: Changing an identifier exposes another customer's data and indicates an authorization bypass.
rationales.security-04: A live production secret is an exposed credential requiring security escalation.

cases.title: Assistive-technology blockers receive accessibility routing

oldGuideline.text: Route all web and mobile interface defects to Product Bugs. Route general suggestions about appearance to Product Feedback.

newGuideline.text: Route ordinary interface defects to Product Bugs. Route blockers involving screen readers, keyboard-only navigation, focus order, captions, contrast, or other assistive technology to Accessibility.

cases.changeSummary: Interface defects that block assistive-technology use now go to Accessibility.

records.text: The settings modal is misaligned on my phone.
My screen reader announces every checkout button as unlabeled.
Please add a darker theme.
I cannot reach the submit button using only the keyboard.
The logo looks blurry on a large monitor.
The page reloads after I choose a filter.
Could you offer more profile colors?
The mouse cursor flickers over the menu.
The mobile header takes too much space.
The date picker chooses yesterday after midnight.

rationales.a11y-04: The missing keyboard path is an accessibility blocker.

cases.title: Already-filed chargebacks split from billing investigation

oldGuideline.text: Route duplicate charges, unknown charges, and requests to dispute a payment to Billing Investigation. Route general bank-transfer questions to Payment Methods.

newGuideline.text: Route duplicate or unknown charges to Billing Investigation unless the customer has already filed a chargeback or bank dispute. Once a bank dispute, card dispute, or chargeback is filed, route the case to Dispute Management.

cases.changeSummary: Cases with a chargeback or bank dispute already filed now go to Dispute Management.

records.text: Why did you charge me twice for one order?
My bank opened a chargeback yesterday; what evidence do you need?
I do not recognize a five-dollar charge.
Can I pay by direct bank transfer?
I might contact my bank if this is not fixed.
The merchant name on my statement is confusing.
I already filed a card dispute for transaction TX-91.
Please explain how chargebacks work before I decide.
The bank transfer is still pending.
The amount is correct, but the date looks wrong.

rationales.dispute-02: The bank has already opened a chargeback.
rationales.dispute-07: The customer explicitly says a card dispute has already been filed.

cases.title: Multi-customer impact escalates individual technical reports

oldGuideline.text: Route reports that a service or feature is unavailable to Technical Support. Only monitoring-system alerts are routed to Service Incident.

newGuideline.text: Route isolated service failures to Technical Support. Route reports that identify multiple affected customers, an entire team, all branches, or a region-wide outage to Service Incident, even when reported by an individual user.

cases.changeSummary: User reports with explicit multi-customer or regional impact now go to Service Incident.

records.text: Only my desktop client cannot connect.
Every agent in our 40-person support team lost access at once.
The status monitor fired an outage alert.
My colleague forgot her password.
All six of our regional branches are seeing gateway errors.
One report takes a long time to load for me.
Is scheduled maintenance planned for Sunday?
My internet provider is currently offline.
Two tabs in my browser froze.
The status page says everything is healthy.

rationales.outage-02: The report states that an entire 40-person team is affected.
rationales.outage-05: The report identifies simultaneous impact across all regional branches.

cases.title: Regulated-text mistranslations receive compliance escalation

oldGuideline.text: Route missing, awkward, or incorrect translations to Localization Quality. Route legal questions about the original English text to Compliance.

newGuideline.text: Route ordinary interface and help-text translation problems to Localization Quality. Route mistranslations of consent language, safety warnings, prices, contractual terms, or required legal disclaimers to Compliance Localization.

cases.changeSummary: Mistranslations in regulated or contractual text now go to Compliance Localization.

records.text: The French menu uses an awkward word for Settings.
The Spanish consent checkbox says I refuse when the English says I agree.
A help article has one untranslated heading.
The German checkout translates $10.00 as $100.00.
Can you add support for Finnish?
The original English contract seems unfair.
The Japanese button text is clipped visually.
The translated greeting sounds too formal.
The language selector forgets my choice.
One FAQ answer is still in English.

rationales.locale-02: The mistranslation reverses consent language and therefore requires compliance review.
rationales.locale-04: The mistranslated price is regulated transaction information.
